fields.name: remaining_targets
fields.description: For goals requesting only one pickup, omit this field and write empty memory at every decision. For goals requesting multiple pickups, this field is an ordered list of [y, x] container locations for the pickups requested by the goal that have not yet been completed. The following initialization and update rules apply only to those multiple-pickup goals. At the first decision step, associate each requested cube color with the container that covered its location in the demonstration, and list those container centers in the order requested. Ignore containers covering unrequested colors and empty distractors. Remove the first entry at the first decision step showing that its container has been successfully grasped and lifted, not at the step choosing the pickup. Putting a container down does not restore its entry. Otherwise preserve the list and its coordinates. Thus episode 7 has [[81, 95], [66, 143]] at step 1 and [[66, 143]] at both steps 2 and 3. The initial lists for episodes 4, 17, 30, and 93 are respectively [[84, 156]], [[95, 156]], [[125, 126]], and [[70, 108]]. e.g. [[81, 95], [66, 143]]
